messages:
maya: Noticing intermittent TLS handshakes west->east after yesterday's KMS hardening PR. Envoy logs show ALPN mismatch. Staging impacted, prod not yet. Anyone seen this?
liam: I'm oncall. Can you paste the envoy error and the KMS binding diff?
maya: envoy: `[2025-04-02T14:05:12Z] envoy svc-proxy-west: TLS alert: handshake failure (ALPN mismatch) peer=svc-core-east cert=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck/versions/4`
ana: Do we know if the cert-issuer uses KMS AsymmetricSign or just key material fetch?
maya: cert-issuer calls AsymmetricSign to sign CSRs. The PR removed a GRANT on some regional keyVersions for tighter RBAC.
tom: Hypothesis: west nodes hit a different keyVersion that lost the sign grant and cert-issuer fell back to cached certs advertising http/1.1 while east expects h2 -> ALPN mismatch.
liam: Quick mitigations: (1) re-add binding to the specific keyVersion in us-west1, (2) accept both ALPNs in envoy temporarily, (3) rollback PR. Which is least risk?
ana: I'll re-add the binding to the affected keyVersion scoped to cert-issuer SA. Command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ck --location=us-west1 --keyring=kr --member=serviceAccount:cert-issuer@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner`
ana: Doing it now, ETA 3m.
security-bot: Alert: Missing `AsymmetricSign` audit entries for svc-proxy-west nodes between 2025-04-02T14:00:00Z and 2025-04-02T14:10:00Z.
infra-oncall: If binding added, please force re-issue leaf certs so ALPN metadata matches. Keep the temp grant until we have a region-aware policy plan.
maya: Binding added at 2025-04-02T14:07:05Z. Triggered cert re-issue. Handshakes dropped to baseline within ~5m.
liam: Verified AsymmetricSign entries for west nodes at 14:07:30Z.
tom: Followups: add a preflight in KMS PRs to run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` for all keyVersions referenced by cert-issuer, add alert for missing KMS usage per service >5m, update cert-issuer to embed explicit ALPN list in cert metadata.
maya: I'll open INC-2025-201 and assign action items. Closing thread after postmortem write-up.
liam: :thumbsup:
